# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/world_magic.mjs, docs/specs/03_gameplay/04_magic_and_world_systems.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Effects of the world layer of magic and its weekly tick. Arguments are temporary variables zin_arg_<name> (E1).
zin_world_raise_varners_wards = {
	# Varner's wards rise once (zin_varner_wards_raised blocks a second call; rule 5). Eindil's host (global.zin_eindil_host, else this scope)
	# takes the wards for 90 days and counts as having potent magic; every other realm at war with Zol's Mistake on the host's side takes the
	# shelter (not potent) and the report zin_world.40. zin_eindil.97 tells the host itself.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_varner_wards_raised } }
		set_global_flag = zin_varner_wards_raised
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_varners_wards days = 90 }
				set_country_flag = zin_world_ward_host
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_world_ward_host }
						has_war_together_with = PREV
						any_enemy_country = { zin_is_zol = yes }
					}
					add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_varners_shelter days = 90 }
					country_event = { id = zin_world.40 }
				}
				clr_country_flag = zin_world_ward_host
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_varners_wards days = 90 }
			set_country_flag = zin_world_ward_host
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_world_ward_host }
					has_war_together_with = PREV
					any_enemy_country = { zin_is_zol = yes }
				}
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_varners_shelter days = 90 }
				country_event = { id = zin_world.40 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = zin_world_ward_host
		}
	}
}
zin_world_grant_new_gods_gift = {
	# The New Gods restore Eindil once (rule 5): only while he bears Glo himself (zin_glo_state 1), never a second bearer, never twice. The journey
	# sets zin_eindil_restored before the call, so the gift keeps its own once-flag. The host (global.zin_eindil_host, else this scope) takes The
	# Gods' Gift for 365 days and the report zin_world.45 comes from the journey's zin_eindil.98.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_gods_gift_given }
			check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_world_gods_gift_given
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_new_gods_gift days = 365 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_new_gods_gift days = 365 }
		}
	}
}
zin_world_give_dragon = {
	# Argument zin_arg_to (a country). Takes one dragon from the pool of Dragon Mountain (global.zin_dragons_free, never refilled in the
	# Fourth Age) and hands it to warfare's zin_war_grant_dragons in that country. Does nothing when the pool is empty. The callers count their
	# own Pacts and bindings.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_to = zin_arg_to }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_to
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dragons_free > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_dragons_free = -1 }
		var:zin_to = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_amount = 1 }
			zin_war_grant_dragons = yes
		}
	}
}

zin_world_mountain_pulse = {
	# The Mountain Wakes: while a realm that is not elven owns Dragon Mountain, the pool is frozen and the companies of non-elven realms on the
	# mountain lose strength every month; the owner hears of it once (zin_world.56).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { zin_world_roosts_free = yes } }
		damage_units = {
			state = 1361
			army = yes
			str_damage = 0.05
			ratio = yes
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_people_elves } }
		}
		1361 = {
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_world_mountain_woke } }
					set_country_flag = zin_world_mountain_woke
					country_event = { id = zin_world.56 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_world_wall_month = {
	# The Great Wall (zin_is_site_great_wall states). The holder is the realm that owns most wall states (country flag zin_world_wall_holder,
	# global event target zin_world_wall_holder). The Wall Unmanned (zin_world.59, at most every 90 days): the holder is at war with a realm that
	# borders a wall state and keeps fewer companies in wall states than half their number (each state counts up to 3). The Wall Is
	# Breached (zin_world.60, once per war): the holder's enemies control 2 or more of its wall states; the Gathering Dark rises by
	# 3 and the holder takes The Wall Has Fallen for 180 days.
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_wall_holder }
		event_target:zin_world_wall_holder = { clr_country_flag = zin_world_wall_holder }
	}
	clear_global_event_target = zin_world_wall_holder
	set_temp_variable = { zin_w_best = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_great_wall = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_w_n = 0 }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_great_wall = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_w_n = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_w_n > zin_w_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_w_best = zin_w_n }
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_wall_holder
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_wall_holder }
		event_target:zin_world_wall_holder = {
			set_country_flag = zin_world_wall_holder
			if = {
				limit = { has_war = no }
				clr_country_flag = zin_world_wall_breached
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					zin_world_wall_threatened = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_world_wall_unmanned_told }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_w_total = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_w_men = 0 }
				every_owned_state = {
					limit = { zin_is_site_great_wall = yes }
					add_to_temp_variable = { zin_w_total = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_w_id = THIS }
					if = {
						limit = {
							PREV = {
								meta_trigger = {
									text = { divisions_in_state = { state = [S] size > 0 } }
									S = "[?zin_w_id]"
								}
							}
						}
						add_to_temp_variable = { zin_w_men = 1 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							PREV = {
								meta_trigger = {
									text = { divisions_in_state = { state = [S] size > 1 } }
									S = "[?zin_w_id]"
								}
							}
						}
						add_to_temp_variable = { zin_w_men = 1 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							PREV = {
								meta_trigger = {
									text = { divisions_in_state = { state = [S] size > 2 } }
									S = "[?zin_w_id]"
								}
							}
						}
						add_to_temp_variable = { zin_w_men = 1 }
					}
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_w_total = 0.5 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_w_men < zin_w_total } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = zin_world_wall_unmanned_told value = 1 days = 90 }
					country_event = { id = zin_world.59 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_world_wall_breached } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_w_lost = 0 }
				every_owned_state = {
					limit = {
						zin_is_site_great_wall = yes
						NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV }
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { zin_w_lost = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_w_lost value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
					set_country_flag = zin_world_wall_breached
					add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_world_wall_fallen days = 180 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
					zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
					country_event = { id = zin_world.60 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_world_magic_month = {
	# The monthly steps of the magic tick: the mountain, the wall, Eindil's reserved dragon (the Keeper's Pact with the journey takes one dragon
	# from the pool when zin_eindil_dragon_pact is set), the storm warning, then the story AI's monthly rules (modules/story_ai.mjs).
	zin_world_mountain_pulse = yes
	zin_world_wall_month = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eindil_dragon_pact
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_eindil_dragon_reserved }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_world_eindil_dragon_reserved
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dragons_free > 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_dragons_free = -1 }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { zin_world_storm_spared = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_world_storms_told }
			has_navy_size = { size > 0 }
			any_enemy_country = {
				zin_world_storm_spared = yes
				any_owned_state = { is_coastal = yes }
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_world_storms_told
		country_event = { id = zin_world.65 }
	}
	zin_story_ai_month = yes
}
zin_world_magic_tick = {
	# The magic tick (spec, "The world tick": the weekly pulses): once a week on the runner; the timed flag zin_world_tick_week keeps a second chain
	# from running twice. Every 4th week it runs zin_world_magic_month.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_tick_week } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = zin_world_tick_week value = 1 days = 5 }
		zin_world_storm_pulse = yes
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_world_magic_week = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_world_magic_week value = 4 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_world_magic_week = 0 }
			zin_world_magic_month = yes
		}
		zin_world_schedule_magic_tick = yes
	}
}
zin_world_schedule_magic_tick = {
	# Picks the runner of the next week (the first country of data/world_magic.json "runners" that exists, else the realm with the most states)
	# and schedules zin_world.30 there in 7 days. The runner carries the country flag zin_world_magic_runner, which on_annex reads.
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_magic_runner }
		event_target:zin_world_magic_runner = { clr_country_flag = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	clear_global_event_target = zin_world_magic_runner
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AEN }
		AEN = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = LER }
		LER = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CLD }
		CLD = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PUV }
		PUV = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GOL }
		GOL = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GAA }
		GAA = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SEL }
		SEL = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = WOR }
		WOR = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_w_best = 0 }
		every_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_w_best } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_w_best = num_of_controlled_states }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_magic_runner
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_magic_runner }
		event_target:zin_world_magic_runner = {
			set_country_flag = zin_world_magic_runner
			country_event = { id = zin_world.30 days = 7 }
		}
	}
}
